workarounds.note: the run-in terms take their red from bodyText.boldColor instead of a :::paragraphs style: a style's spaceBetween is also added after the container's last paragraph and does not merge into the next heading's marginTop, which left three blank lines above section 5 against two above every other section

each side-head box sits between its heading and the section's first paragraph, which in 1.4.1 gives that paragraph a first-line indent whatever indentAfterHeading says; the report texture has no indent, so nothing shows, and Pitfalls gives the fix for an indented texture

the programme table floats to the head of the text column (position 'top', cited with :ref) instead of sitting where it is cited: as an inline 'here' table it moved to the head of page 3, and the page-wide elevation cited on page 2 then skipped page 3 and opened page 4
ragged text gets no runt control, so the paragraphs that ended on one short word ('Europea.', 'bóvedas.', 'conservarse.') were reworded by hand until no paragraph ends on a single word
a no-break space is not trusted to hold a figure to its unit: the sentences that split '10 / %', '12 / kN/m²' and '4.000 / €' were reworded until each pair sits mid-line

the site plan is an image element of the opener and reserves no height: minHeight carries the reserve to its foot, rounded up to a whole grid line so that section 1 keeps the same distance from rule to text as every other section

col() writes each colour's hex beside its paletteId, because 1.4.1 paints design elements (section numbers, rules, hanging numbers, the opener, the letterhead) from the hex, and bodyText.referenceColor is restated in ink
every design text lineHeight is a multiple of its size (LEAD / 10.5 for the subsection title, LEAD / 9 for its number), never a dimension
resourceTypes: defaultResourceTypes('es') prints Figura and Tabla; without it the captions and references would say Figure and Table
the H1 breakBefore is restated (parity 'any') because a headings object drops it; in a brief with one H1 it changes nothing
